item.title: Israeli strike in Gaza City kills new head of Hamas's military wing
item.description: At least three people were killed in the attack, which came despite a ceasefire with Hamas being in place.

item.title: Dozens killed in Lebanon as Israel intensifies strikes
item.description: Israel says it struck 100 Hezbollah infrastructure sites and fighters in Lebanon, after PM Benjamin Netanyahu vows to "crush" the Iran-backed group.

item.title: Iran condemns US strikes as 'gross violation' of ceasefire
item.description: The attacks took place while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks.

item.title: Israel orders evacuation of Lebanese city as conflict with Hezbollah escalates
item.description: Israel's military tells residents of Tyre it will "act forcefully" against the armed group, after another wave of strikes in south and east Lebanon.

item.title: Ebola-hit DR Congo faces 'catastrophic collision' of disease and conflict, WHO warns
item.description: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said fighting in DR Congo was hampering efforts to stop spread

item.title: Trump-backed challenger beats veteran US senator in Texas primary
item.description: Ken Paxton's victory sets up what will be a closely watched contest in November's midterm elections.

item.title: Can EU find a Russia whisperer to mediate an end to war in Ukraine?
item.description: With the US pulling out of trilateral talks with Russia and Ukraine, the EU is looking for potential candidates to step in.
